verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks of a black snake.
It’s filthy, stinking, cowardly, frightening, and treacherous.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe.
verses.english: These are the five dangers of a black snake.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcime ādīnavā mātugāme.
verses.english: In the same way there are five drawbacks of a lady.
She’s filthy, stinking, cowardly, frightening, and treacherous.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā mātugāme”ti.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks of a lady.”
